name: ECO-DOC
evidence: gatekeeper-cli.sh self-check reports no new issues

structural_checks.command: bash gatekeeper-cli.sh self-check 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('PASS' if any(c.get('check')=='gitnexus' and c.get('status')!='FAIL' for c in d.get('checks',[])) else 'WARN')"
bash gatekeeper-cli.sh state 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('PASS' if d.get('stage')=='ECO-DOC' else 'FAIL')"
